content: We take the most frequent 20k words as our vocabulary and use the GloVe word embeddings BIBREF20 for initialization. The embedding dimensions for POS, NER, answer position are set to 20. We use two-layer LSTMs in both encoder and decoder, and the LSTMs hidden unit size is set to 600.
